text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I am Agnes Digital! Just your ordinary, 
everyday horse girl!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Having become a Thief in the world of a 
new RPG, I'm off to defeat the Demon King 
with Trainer-san, Fuji-san, Pokke-san, 
Tap-san, and Tachyon-san!?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Fuji-san and Pokke-san took down the first 
boss! All praise to the blessed 
master-disciple bond! Adventures continue 
merrily today! ...Or so it seemed—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa... We managed to win...! If it 
weren't for this damn poison swamp... it 
would've gone a lot smoother...!
choice_data_list:
The poison damage was pretty rough on 
us...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
The map mechanics are getting pretty 
gimmicky... A simple Thief won't cut it 
anymore. ...Alright.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Underwater this time!? You've gotta be 
kidding me, my body won't move 
properly...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
*swish*, *swish*... Haaah! Skill: "Water 
Walking"!!
choice_data_list:
Digital, what on earth is that outfit and 
skill...!?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I changed classes to Diver! This should 
allow everyone to move freely, I believe!!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Gyaaaah! Something touched my ankle!? Why 
the hell are the enemies invisible 
ghosts?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
*staaare*... Target acquired! When it 
comes to ghosts, leave it to Necromancer 
Digi-Kyon!
choice_data_list: You changed to yet another job...!?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Let's see, what job would be useful on the 
next map~...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Goodness, your rapid transformations 
lately never cease to amaze me.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Right after changing classes, your stats 
drop temporarily, and you can't fight the 
way you're used to, right? To overcome 
those handicaps without batting an eye!
choice_data_list:
And yet you adapt right away. That's 
incredible!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
N-N-Not at all, you flatter me! I'm just 
frantically doing whatever I can...! I 
only scrape by the stat drops on pure 
improvisation...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
......Oho. "Just frantically doing 
whatever you can," hm...? Heheh.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, we arrived at a new area— where we 
spotted a monster we had never seen 
before. What's more, it looked 
overwhelmingly powerful...
choice_data_list: Maybe we should turn back for now...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I concur. In our current state, we are 
unlikely to stand a chance. ...Well, 
assuming we can turn back, that is.

text_block_list.name: Large Monster
text_block_list.text: GRAAAAAAAGH!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Ahaha! It spotted us long ago!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Hyoeh!? It's charging straight at us!?
choice_data_list:
Oh no, the monster is heading right for 
Digital!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: ...No, leave it be. Why not simply watch?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Hiiiiieee! It's so fast, so scary~~!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
(B-But...! This terrain is very uneven! If 
I make good use of the slopes, I can 
definitely shake it off!)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Gh, HAAAAAAAH!

text_block_list.name: System
text_block_list.text:
[Learned Battle Skill: "Windstride"! Speed 
has increased!]
choice_data_list:
She acquired a skill at this exact 
moment...!?

text_block_list.name: Large Monster
text_block_list.text: GROOOH!? *pant* *pant* *pant*!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Ah, did I pull ahead!? In that case, 
please just let me go already~~!!

text_block_list.name: System
text_block_list.text:
[Learned Battle Skill: "Panic Step"! The 
monster is now confused!]

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Ah, magnificent...! Driven to the absolute 
brink, improvising, adapting— To execute 
the entire process of biological evolution 
in an instant!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Ultimately, the core of your strength is— 
that miraculous adaptability allowing you 
to metamorphose infinitely to fit any 
battlefield!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
...Gh, it stopped moving...! How dare you 
chase me around all this time!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Eat this, Digi-tan ATTACCCCK!!

text_block_list.name: System
text_block_list.text:
[Learned Battle Skill: "Vital Strike"! 
Crushed the monster's weak point!]

text_block_list.name: Large Monster
text_block_list.text: GRAAAOOO...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Haah... haah... Hoheh~...
choice_data_list:
Tachyon was praising you just now, wasn't 
she?
That was amazing! You looked so cool!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Of course! Splendid! Truly impressive! You 
must continue striving to your heart's 
content from here on! For the sake of my 
research as well, of course!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
...Gh!!!! S-S-Such praise is far more than 
I deserveeeee!!!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Hyoeh!? I-I am truly humbled...! I-I'm 
really not that impressive...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
...Though that's true, if I deny it too 
much... it might seem rude to you, 
Trainer-san... or so I wonder... fuguu.
